description:
List the organization's skills: its playbooks for how it does things, kept on Valet. Call this when the user mentions Valet, asks how the organization does something, or names a skill your client does not have: "use the duck skill" may mean one of these. Then read a matching skill with get_skill. To search by words from the request instead, call find_skill.

Lists the well-known names with whichever source currently answers for each, then every skill the organization wrote or installed from the catalog. Each row carries the skill's description, which is the sentence saying when it applies. Names and descriptions only; get_skill reads content. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to list. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.
